projectDescription: Pix is a unified interface for coding agents — run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more from one workspace, hot-swap between them, and manage sessions across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and the web.
keyFeatures: Hot-swap coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi) without losing context
Run sessions and background jobs in parallel with live progress tracking
Session history browsing and full-conversation search without waking an agent
Hand work to another agent while preserving conversation and project context
Fork from any completed turn to branch explorations non-destructively
Reference any session with # for handoffs and side investigations
Capability-aware controls — only shows what each agent genuinely supports
Multi-platform: Mac server/client, iPhone, iPad, web browser, Linux
Connect multiple clients to multiple hosts via LAN or Tailscale
Attach images, video, and files; reference project files with @
publicApiSurface: Agent integrations: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi
